description: This file defines the class MongoEntitiesPersistenceOperations, which implements EntityPersistenceOperations for managing persistence operations on entities stored in MongoDB within an event sourcing context. It provides methods to purge entities and interacts with MongoDB collections using reactive streams.

classes.name: MongoEntitiesPersistenceOperations
classes.description: A final class implementing entity persistence operations for MongoDB event source storage, providing functionality such as entity purge.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of MongoEntitiesPersistenceOperations with the specified MongoDatabase and settings.

methods.name: purgeEntity
methods.description: Public method to purge all data related to a specific EntityId from MongoDB, returning a reactive stream of possible errors.
